context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the implement-calculator-pattern instructions from the published Ruby Core Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Write the spec/test — contexts per variant, plus the NullService path

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run it — verify it fails because the component does not exist yet

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run again — confirm green, then proceed to the next component

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: the next component starts. Do not collapse NullService and concrete services

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Test coverage: Factory, NullService, and every concrete service must cover named variants, inactive plan, nil plan, and unknown variant contexts (or explicitly explain why a context does not apply).

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Create the **Factory**. No qualifying context or unknown variant → `NullService`.

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Create the **BaseService**. Define `calculate` that delegates to `compute_result` if `should_calculate?` is true.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Create the **NullService**. Always return false for `should_calculate?` and nil for `compute_result`.

checklist.name: instruction-9
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Create **Concrete** services. Override `should_calculate?` and `compute_result`. Always call `super` in `should_calculate?`.

checklist.name: instruction-10
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run the full test suite.
